title: Frame Less
description: FrameLess removes item frame borders for a clean and minimal display while keeping your builds simple and vanilla-friendly.
body:
FrameLess Resource Pack

FrameLess makes item frames completely invisible, giving your builds a cleaner and more modern look while keeping displayed items fully visible. Perfect for decoration, storage rooms, maps, shops, and aesthetic builds without bulky frame borders getting in the way.

Features:

- Invisible item frames
- Clean and minimal look
- Better item displays
- Vanilla-friendly style
- Lightweight and simple
- Great for Survival and Creative
- Perfect for aesthetic builds and storage systems
